### ✅ PHP Function to Paginate an Array

```php
<?php
function paginateArray($array, $perPage = 10, $page = 1) {
    // Calculate the start index
    $start = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

    // Slice the array
    $paginated = array_slice($array, $start, $perPage);

    return $paginated;
}
?>
```

---

```php
$perPage = 5;
$page = 2;

?>
```
